summary: Comprehensive plan to scrap current DevLys 010 mapping and replace it across the entire application with the official standard Remington GAIL layout (DevLys 010 / Kruti Dev 010) as prescribed by RSMSSB/RSSB. Incorporates full keyboard layout synchronization, standard NumPad Alt codes, ligature combiners, and updates to the engine, drills, exam runners, and visualizer.
